profile.headline: Software Engineer at Hunter Douglas, Inc.
profile.summary:
My focus has been continuous intellectual improvement.  My goal is to leverage my intellectual capital to disrupt the status quo in order to elevate in any way the sustainability of human civilization and the global standard of living.
To that end science and technology is our most powerful tools but they are dependent on our ability to collect, disseminate, and analyze ever increasing quantities of information as efficiently and accurately as possible.  Thus I have worked to find solutions that bring communication and analytics to the industrial sector in a way that drives the economy and produces jobs.
